title: Walls Have Ears
text: “Gaelion, I heard you took some of Raphtalia’s fur—can you tell me what you were planning to do with it?”
“I was trying to get the Spear Hero to create a Raph-species—Naofumi’s favorite creature. It’s something I had to do.”
“Um… my favorite?”

“That’s right. It’s a creature the Wild Naofumi from the first world created when he went crazy. Even after he returned to normal, he still liked it, and it’s a creature he’d create and like in other loops too.”
“Wait, why does it have to be Raphtalia’s hair as the material?”
“Well, that’s because we create it using Rafu’s hair as the base. That’s why it’s called the ‘Raph-species.’ Oh, and there are subspecies like the ‘Tally Species’ and the ‘Ria Species,’ too.”
Just then, Itsuki suddenly appeared. He was using a stealth skill, wasn’t he!?
“Walls have ears, and sliding doors have eyes.”
“Itsuki… why?”
“Well, I was eavesdropping because I thought something was up. It just goes to show that stealth skills aren’t exclusive to Motoyasu-san.”
“I thought I was asking why you were using a stealth skill in the first place…”
“It’s obvious—I was running away from Fleon-san, of course. And while I was doing that, I happened to come across a scene that looked interesting.”

Well, the Cloaking Lance I use is powered by a holy weapon, after all. Any Hero who’s acquired the Skills should be able to use something similar. But what’s with Itsuki’s attitude here? Come to think of it, Fleon-chan was also darting around all over the place, interacting with all sorts of people. It must be true that Itsuki and Fleon-chan get along well.
“So, Gaelion, are these Raph-species really creatures that Naofumi likes that much? To the point of being completely out of the ordinary?”
“It’s true that Wild Naofumi has become pathologically obsessed with the Raph-species and can’t stop petting them.”
“I’m in favor of creating them. Let’s ask Ren-san, too. I’m sure he’ll agree. Gaelion-san, in situations like this, the first step is to gather as many as possible.”
Satisfied with his Rival’s response, Itsuki turned toward his Father and raised his hand.
“Oh my—”
Itsuki took a badge from his chest, pressed a button, and said,
“Hello, Ren-san? Please come over here. Something interesting is happening right now.”
“What’s that—it looks like something a young detective would carry.”
“I’ve been in touch with various engineers. It can handle voice communication within the village’s range.”
“You two sure have some strange gadgets, Itsuki and Ren…”
That’s true. I wonder where they got a device like this? Still, “within the village’s range” is a bit of a vague definition. Before long, Ren suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
“What’s up? What’s this ‘interesting’ business?”
“You really came… or rather, keep talking like that.”
He’s still looking pretty pathetic, as usual. And to think he managed to slip past Black Thunder and the others using stealth… that’s just cruel. Black Thunder’s crying.
“I’ll give some to Naofumi-san later, too. Let me know if anything comes up.”
“Ah… yeah. Got it.”
“Aren’t you going to give me any?”
“If I gave it to you, you’d spill the beans on where we’re staying. I won’t give it to you, of all people.”
Itsuki’s response is pretty harsh. All I want to do is tell Fleon and Black Thunder where Ren and Itsuki are staying.
“So?”
“Well, apparently they can create a creature capable of brainwashing Naofumi-san. They’re discussing whether or not to make it.”
“I see. I’m all for it.”
“Listen…”
“We want some allies. Naofumi, you should know the terror of brainwashing, too.”
“Well, even if you say that… I’d really prefer you didn’t try to recruit me, though…”
My Father doesn’t seem too enthusiastic either. Maybe there’s no need to make one after all?
“Don’t say that—you should just make one. Naofumi, if you do, it’ll help with the problems at Rafu at night.”
“Ah… Will it actually be useful in that regard?”
My Big Sister still can’t stop screaming from her trauma while she sleeps. Every night, Father and Big Sister’s older sister take turns looking after her.
“That’s right.”
“Hmm…”

“It doesn’t have to be a Rafu—we can make something similar, so a Sadeena would work too. In that case, we could name it the ‘Sadi-species.’ In this loop, Naofumi might actually prefer that. It’s a little orca from Tsurupuni.”
“Oh my—what should we do, Naofumi-chan? If I had to choose, the kind of girl who’d be friends with Raphtalia-chan probably likes Raphtalia-chan more than me.”
Big Sister’s Big Sister is subtly steering the conversation.
“Sadeena-onee-san!?”
“So we’re definitely making it!?”
Big Sister let out a cry of surprise, and Father fired off a question.
“Or would Naofumi prefer a Panda? That would definitely be more up Naofumi’s alley. Or maybe Imiya-neechan?”
“I don’t know exactly what it’ll look like, but will it be like a stuffed animal? A raccoon dog, a killer whale, a Panda, or a Mole?”
“But we’re already moving forward with the assumption that we’re definitely making it, right?”
“That’s fine. Come to think of it, I was wondering—you won’t be using Gaelion-san’s own DNA to make it, will you?”
“Oh, that’s out of the question—it’s too risky in all sorts of ways.”
“What’s so risky about it?”
“You’ll find out eventually. Besides, the Spear Hero would hate it if we used dragon DNA.”
“That’s only natural.”
I’d rather die than mass-produce Rivales.
“Ah, I see. That makes sense.”
“So why are we moving forward with making one?”
“Because there’s a lot of support for it. Naofumi, which one do you like best?”
“If it doesn’t work out, we’ll help out. Even if Motoyasu can’t do it, we can. The only question is what skills are needed.”
“Aren’t you just trying to put me in a bind?”
“We want some allies. You, Naofumi, who won’t stop Motoyasu, have no right to object.”
“Normally, I would! Fine, though. As long as it doesn’t go against morality or common sense… Is creating living things really a good thing?”
Your father has some doubts.
“Um…”
Big Sister is trying to step in and make her point.

“Don’t worry, Rahu! It’ll definitely be a creature that becomes your friend! I don’t understand why Gaelion won’t reveal his name either, but that’s just the kind of guy he is. In every loop, he takes pleasure in staying completely hidden.”

By the way, my Rival mentioned later that even though it should have been possible to just restore it as-is, the person in question apparently said something about wanting a monster instead. He was muttering under his breath about how restoring it as-is would cause glitches due to the degradation of the soul, or that it’s impossible to fully restore it, or that there’s a risk of people finding it unsettling, and so on.
“If Naofumi can’t decide, then the Bow Hero can make the call.”

“Me? Well… if we use Sadeena or Larsazusa, there might be unnecessary interference, so I think Raphtalia—who can use other loop-related knowledge—would be best. I’d prefer Sadeena if possible, though.”
“That’s the safest bet.”
“It’s settled, then.”
“I’d prefer you didn’t just decide on your own, though.”
“I’ll explain the reasoning to Naofumi a bit later, so let’s just move the conversation forward for now.”
And so, through and through, we were left with no choice but to recreate the Raph-species using Big Sister’s hair.
“Lord Motoyasu! Do you wish to increase the number of Filolials like this, Lord Motoyasu? If so, I’ll provide some of mine, too!”
Yuki-chan must have gotten curious during the cultivation process, because she came over to ask.
“Do you want me to mix it with the Spear Hero’s hair?”
“Y-You don’t have to comply with the Dragon’s request!”
“Understood.”

Is this going to be a creature made by mixing mine and Yuki-chan’s? I think creating such a creature would be blasphemous. Filolial-sama is great, after all. That said, regarding the creation of the Raph-species, my Father, after my Big Sister’s older sister and a Rival had a discussion, decided to go ahead with it with a certain degree of understanding. Since we didn’t have a Bio-Plant, we used various substitutes along with our equipment to finally complete it. I’ve gotten quite used to this by now.
“All that’s left is this—”
Saying something like that, Rival smoothly inserted the crystal she’d created when she discovered my Big Sister into the Raph-species. Is that a necessary ingredient?
“It’s done!”
And just like that, we’ve perfectly recreated the Raph-species. We took the finished Raph-species out and brought it to the village square to show my Father and the others.
“Rafu!”
The newly completed Raph-species responded to the Rival’s voice by spreading its arms wide and chirping.
“Look, Naofumi-san! You’ve got yourself a natural enemy!”
“Wow… it turned out pretty cute, didn’t it?”
“Rafu.”
When Father reached out to the Raph-species, it went over on its own to be petted.
“I think it’s cute, but I’m not sure I’d go so far as to say I’m obsessed with it… Look, Raphtalia, they say this little one is going to be your friend.”
“Rafu!”

Held under the armpits by Father, the Raph-species was lifted up and held out to Big Sister, just like a stuffed animal. Tilting its little head, the Raph-species raised one paw toward Big Sister and chirped affectionately. The Big Sister furrowed her brow as she accepted the Raph-species that was offered to her.
“Ah, somehow… that’s a bit of a relief.”
“If anything happens, please protect her just like you always have. I want you to take good care of her.”
“…? Yeah.”
As if she’d just received a stuffed animal, the Big Sister nodded in response to her Rival’s words.
“Gaelion-san, does that mean it’ll take a little while longer for Naofumi-san to become completely smitten?”
“When does the corruption start?”
“Why don’t we talk things over with Itsuki and Ren later? Specifically, I think I’ll have them spend a few hours in the same room with Fleon-chan and Black Thunder.”
Oh! That’s it! It’s that room you can’t leave without being brainwashed! Ren and Itsuki will come out as the Dark Holy Hero and Filolial Mask V3.
“You monster, Naofumi!”
“No way in hell! I’ll show you I can escape with everything I’ve got!”

Crackle, crackle—my Father, Ren, and Itsuki have started a staring contest. I suppose it’s time for me to join in. I’ll use my Paralyze Lance to capture Ren and Itsuki alive and hand them over to Fleon-chan and the others. Just as I raised my lance to aim at Itsuki, my hand was shot right through with a *smack*.
“Ouch!? That hurt!”
“Motoyasu, you’re letting your killing intent slip through!”
“Ah, right. We’ll wait to see when Naofumi awakens, then make our escape!”
Damn… they’re quietly becoming harder to exploit. How can I turn this into the tree Fleon wants? It seems like silencing it by force would be the quickest way.
“Motoyasu-kun, don’t force things. I don’t think Fleon would be happy with that kind of coercion either.”
Ugh… I just got scolded by my Father. Fleon… I’ll find a way to awaken the Itsuki, so please wait for me! Anyway, that’s how I ended up creating the Raph-species.
“Well then, while I was creating the Raph-species, Gaelion also made something.”
“What did you make next, Gaelion?”
“Are you going to do something about Fleon and Black Thunder?”
“I feel like Gaelion-chan is starting to cause as much of a commotion as Motoyasu-kun.”
“It’s lively—that’s a good thing, isn’t it? Big Sister, I’ve been having so much fun lately—every day is full of excitement!”
My fathers are each voicing their grievances about their Rival. But fathers, that’s unfair. Rival is a trouble-making parasite that constantly causes problems.
“Since today is the unveiling party, I’ve sent out invitations.”
“For what? And to whom?”
“Hey! Come over here!”
“Oh?”
“Hmm…?”

The one who came when called… is Sakura-chan! What on earth is going on here? Lately, she’s been leaving the village more often to visit her Finacée. Oh? Her Finacée has come along with Sakura-chan, too.
“What?”
“Hello, all you Four Holy Heroes.”
It seems they’ve come to visit the village. And is that her Assistant? And… here comes Fleon-chan.
“Called and I’m here—Fleon reporting for duty!”
“I think I’ll keep my distance!”
With a whoosh, Itsuki dashes away from the spot and is watching us from afar.
“And give this to Rafu, too.”
After saying that, my Rival hands it to her Big Sister… I recognize that. It’s a Dress-Up Compact!
“Did you make that again?!”
Seeing Filo-tan change outfits was a treat for the eyes, but it seems she made it again in this loop as well.
“Huh? What’s about to happen?”
Father is watching with a puzzled look on his face.
“Right. Does everyone have one?”
“Naofumi, Gaelion told me to hold onto this—”
What Sakura-chan was holding was an item with the same design as the compact Filo-tan had.
